t2.title: Homework be banned in primary schools
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should homework be banned in primary schools?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Homework has been a traditional part of education, but its value for young children is increasingly questioned. I believe homework should be significantly reduced or banned in primary schools.

Firstly, young children need time for unstructured play, which is essential for their social development and creativity. Excessive homework robs them of this valuable time and can lead to burnout at an early age.

Secondly, research suggests homework provides minimal academic benefits for primary school students. Young children learn better through hands-on activities and exploration rather than worksheets. The stress of homework can actually create negative attitudes towards learning.

However, opponents argue that homework teaches responsibility and time management. While these are important skills, they can be developed through other activities appropriate for young children.

Furthermore, homework creates inequality as children from supportive homes receive more help than those whose parents work long hours.

In conclusion, primary school children should focus on playing and exploring rather than completing homework. If assigned, it should be minimal and enjoyable.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
Homework is bad. I like play. School is ok. Homework no.
Bye!
t2.sampleA2: Hello. I think homework is not good for small kids. It is boring and I want to play. I have homework and I don't like it. My friends don't like homework too because it is hard. We want to play games and watch TV. Homework is not fun. So, no homework, please!
t2.sampleB1: I think homework in primary school isn't a good idea. Young children need time to play and relax after school. If they have too much homework, they might get stressed and not enjoy learning. For example, my little brother has homework every day and he always complains about it. He prefers playing with his friends. Also, I think children learn better when they do fun activities, not just worksheets. However, some people say homework helps children learn responsibility. But I believe there are other ways to teach them that. In conclusion, I think primary schools should reduce or even ban homework.
t2.sampleB2: This is such a great topic — I've been mulling it over ever since my niece started primary school! Personally, I'm all for scrapping homework at this age. Little ones spend a good six hours a day in the classroom, and once they get home, they honestly need to switch off. Free play isn't just fun; it's how they build social skills and let their imagination run wild. Piling worksheets on top of a long day often does more harm than good, leaving kids frazzled and fed up with learning before they've even started. That said, I do see where the other side is coming from. A bit of reading with mum or dad can work wonders, and it helps parents stay in the loop. The key, I reckon, is keeping it light — think a bedtime story, not a stack of maths drills. At the end of the day, childhood is short, and I'd rather see kids climbing trees than filling in gaps on a page. What do you all think? Has anyone here actually seen homework benefit a six-year-old? I'd love to hear your take!
t2.uzSample:
Uyga vazifa ta’limning an’anaviy qismi bo‘lib kelgan, ammo uning yosh bolalar uchun qiymati tobora shubha ostiga olinmoqda. Menimcha, boshlang‘ich maktablarda uyga vazifalar sezilarli darajada qisqartirilishi yoki taqiqlanishi kerak.

Birinchidan, yosh bolalarga tartibsiz o‘yinlar uchun vaqt kerak, bu ularning ijtimoiy rivojlanishi va ijodkorligi uchun zarurdir. Haddan tashqari uyga vazifa ularni bu qimmatli vaqtdan mahrum qiladi va erta yoshda charchashga olib kelishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, tadqiqotlar shuni ko‘rsatadiki, uyga vazifa boshlang‘ich maktab o‘quvchilari uchun minimal akademik foyda beradi. Yosh bolalar ish daftarlaridan ko‘ra, amaliy mashg‘ulotlar va o‘rganish orqali yaxshiroq o‘rganadilar. Uyga vazifaning stressi aslida o‘rganishga nisbatan salbiy munosabatni yaratishi mumkin.

Biroq, opponentlar uyga vazifa mas'uliyat va vaqtni boshqarishni o'rgatadi, deb ta'kidlaydilar. Bu muhim ko'nikmalar bo'lsa-da, ularni yosh bolalar uchun mos bo'lgan boshqa tadbirlar orqali rivojlantirish mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, uyga vazifa tengsizlikni yaratadi, chunki qo'llab-quvvatlovchi oilalardan bo'lgan bolalar ota-onalari uzoq soatlar ishlaydiganlarga qaraganda ko'proq yordam oladi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, boshlang‘ich maktab o‘quvchilari uyga vazifalarni bajarishdan ko‘ra o‘ynash va o‘rganishga e’tibor qaratishlari kerak. Agar topshirilsa, u minimal va yoqimli bo'lishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Uyga vazifa yomon. Men o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Maktab yaxshi. Uyga vazifa yo'q.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2: Salom. Men o'ylaymanki, uyga vazifa kichkina bolalar uchun yaxshi emas. Bu zerikarli va men o'ynashni xohlayman. Menda uyga vazifa bor va menga yoqmaydi. Mening do'stlarimga ham uyga vazifa yoqmaydi, chunki u qiyin. Biz o'yinlar o'ynashni va televizor ko'rishni xohlaymiz. Uyga vazifa qiziqarli emas. Shunday ekan, uyga vazifa yo'q, iltimos!
t2.uzSampleB1: Menimcha, boshlang'ich maktabda uyga vazifa berish yaxshi fikr emas. Yosh bolalarga maktabdan keyin o'ynash va dam olish uchun vaqt kerak. Agar ularga juda ko'p uyga vazifa berilsa, ular stressga tushib, o'qishdan zavqlanmasligi mumkin. Misol uchun, mening ukam har kuni uyga vazifa oladi va u doimo bundan shikoyat qiladi. U do'stlari bilan o'ynashni afzal ko'radi. Shuningdek, menimcha, bolalar faqat ish varaqalarini emas, balki qiziqarli mashg'ulotlar bilan shug'ullanganda yaxshiroq o'rganadilar. Biroq, ba'zi odamlar uyga vazifa bolalarga mas'uliyatni o'rganishga yordam beradi, deyishadi. Lekin men ularga buni o'rgatishning boshqa yo'llari borligiga ishonaman. Xulosa qilib aytganda, menimcha, boshlang'ich maktablar uyga vazifani kamaytirishi yoki hatto taqiqlashi kerak.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Boshlang‘ich maktablarda uy vazifasi bo‘yicha bahs murakkab masala. Tarafdorlar uy vazifasi mas’uliyatni singdiradi va sinfda o‘rganilgan bilimlarni mustahkamlaydi, deb ta’kidlasalar-da, menimcha, uning kamchiliklari yosh o‘quvchilar uchun afzalliklaridan ustun turadi.

Birinchidan, haddan tashqari uy vazifasi bolaning farovonligiga salbiy ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin. Boshlang‘ich sinf o‘quvchilariga tartibsiz o‘yinlar, ijodiy mashg‘ulotlar va oila bilan vaqt o‘tkazish uchun yetarli vaqt kerak. Ularni topshiriqlar bilan ortiqcha yuklash stress, xavotir va o‘rganishga bo‘lgan ishtiyoqning pasayishiga olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, bu yoshda uy vazifasining samaradorligi shubhali. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko‘rsatadiki, uning akademik ta’siri sarflangan vaqtga nisbatan minimaldir. Buning o‘rniga, qiziqarli sinf mashg‘ulotlari va amaliy o‘rganish tajribalariga e’tibor qaratish chinakam tushunish va o‘rganishga muhabbatni rivojlantirishga ko‘proq yordam beradi.

Albatta, yaxshi o‘qish odatlarini rivojlantirish muhim, ammo bunga ota-onalar bilan ovoz chiqarib o‘qish yoki ta’limiy o‘yinlar bilan shug‘ullanish kabi muqobil usullar orqali erishish mumkin. Oxir oqibat, boshlang‘ich maktab ta’limga nisbatan ijobiy munosabatni shakllantirish, kashfiyotlar qilish va o‘rganish vaqti bo‘lishi kerak, ortiqcha bosim va stress manbai emas.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who just bought a new car. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! Congratulations on your new car! Keeping it clean can be a hassle, but I found this brilliant solution. CleanDrive comes right to your home and washes your car while you relax. The results are amazing and it saves so much time! You should definitely give it a try. Enjoy your new ride!

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the car wash service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear CleanDrive Team, Thank you for contacting me about my experience with your mobile car wash service. I am extremely satisfied with the service. The convenience of having my car washed at home is invaluable. Your staff were punctual, professional, and my car looked spotlessly clean. The booking app was incredibly easy to use. However, I noticed a few areas for improvement. The interior cleaning was slightly rushed, missing some spots in the back seats. I would suggest allocating more time for detailed cleaning. Additionally, I would appreciate if you offered headlight restoration and engine bay cleaning services. A monthly subscription package with discounted rates would also be attractive to regular customers like myself. Overall, I am very happy and will continue using CleanDrive. Yours sincerely, Ozoda Umarova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi CleanDrive,
Car wash good.
Car clean.
Thank you.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Hello CleanDrive,
Thank you for the car wash. It was good. My car is clean now.
I like the home service because it is easy.
The booking was easy too. But I want you to clean inside the car more.
Thank you again.
Bye.
t12.sampleB1:
Dear CleanDrive Team,

Thank you for the email. I wanted to say that I was happy with the car wash service. It was very convenient that you came to my home. The people who washed the car were nice and my car is very clean now. The booking process was also easy to use, so that's good.

However, I think you could offer some more services. For example, maybe you could clean the inside windows better. Also, I think it would be good if you could offer a service to clean the engine.

Overall, I was happy and I will use your service again.

Sincerely,
Ozoda Umarova
t12.sampleB2: Dear CleanDrive Team, Thank you for reaching out to ask about my recent experience with your mobile car wash. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed. Having my car cleaned on my own driveway was incredibly convenient, and the booking process could not have been more straightforward. Your team arrived on time and left the vehicle looking brand new. That said, there is some room for improvement. The interior could have been given a little more attention, as a few spots were missed under the seats. In future, I would suggest allowing extra time for a proper valet. I would also love to see additional options, such as waxing or an engine clean, along with a discounted monthly plan for regular customers. All in all, I am delighted with the service and will gladly book again. Yours faithfully, Dilnoza Karimova

Hurmatli CleanDrive jamoasi,

Sizning mobil avtomobil yuvish xizmatingiz haqidagi tajribam bo'yicha men bilan bog'langaningiz uchun rahmat.

Men xizmatdan juda mamnunman. Mashinamni uyda yuvdirishning qulayligi beqiyos. Sizning xodimlaringiz o'z vaqtida, professional edilar va mashinam juda toza ko'rinardi. Buyurtma berish ilovasi juda oson edi.

Biroq, men yaxshilanishi kerak bo'lgan bir nechta jihatlarni sezdim. Ichki tozalash biroz shoshilinch bo'lib, orqa o'rindiqlarda ba'zi joylar qolib ketgan. Men batafsil tozalash uchun ko'proq vaqt ajratishni taklif qilaman.

Bundan tashqari, siz faralarni tiklash va dvigatel bo'linmasini tozalash xizmatlarini taklif qilsangiz, men bundan mamnun bo'lardim. Chegirmali narxlarga ega oylik obuna paketi men kabi doimiy mijozlar uchun ham jozibali bo'ladi.

Umuman olganda, men juda xursandman va CleanDrive-dan foydalanishni davom ettiraman.

Hurmat bilan,
Ozoda Umarova

Ehtimol, yanada keng qamrovli ichki tozalash paketini taklif qilish foydali bo'lar edi. Ikkinchidan, agar siz bo'yoqni himoya qilish yoki mumlash kabi xizmatlarni taklif qilsangiz, bu juda foydali bo'lardi. Ushbu qo'shimchalar sizning xizmatingizni yanada jozibali qiladi.

Ushbu kichik kamchiliklarga qaramay, men CleanDrive'dan juda mamnunman va kelajakda albatta sizning xizmatlaringizdan yana foydalanaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Ozoda Umarova
